description: 现代防御150攻击 B06 — 反制练习：在激烈攻击下寻找e5爆破时机

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Practice 8: Modern Defense
White launches a direct kingside attack. Black cannot win by defending passively. Find a way to defend while preparing a counterattack, and decide when the ...e5 break is ready.
intro.popup:
反制中心练习8

现代防御150攻击！

白方直接翼翼攻!
黑方只防会输

练习目标：
在防守的同时寻找反击
e5爆破的时机在哪？

outro.popup_en: Against an attack, do not only defend: ...Qa5 creates counterplay on the queenside, and ...e5 breaks open the center to divert White's forces. The key decision is when to switch from defense to counterattack.
outro.popup:
现代防御总结

被攻击时的反制策略：
① 不能只防守
② Qa5！后反击白方
③ e5！中心爆破分散攻势

关键决策：
何时从防守转为反击？

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops and supports the center.
...Bg7! Black's fianchettoed bishop pressures the center.
O-O-O! White castles long and prepares the h4-h5 pawn storm.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！后翼易位
准备h4-h5翼攻

moves.popup_en: h4! White begins the kingside pawn attack.
Bh6! White attacks Black's fianchettoed bishop.
Qxh6 recaptures and activates White's queen.
...Qa5! Black counterattacks on the queenside with an active queen.
moves.popup:
Qa5！反击！
黑后活跃，攻击白方后翼

moves.popup_en: Kb1 moves White's king to greater safety.
...e5! The critical central break. Black opens the center to disrupt White's kingside attack.
moves.popup:
e5！中心爆破！
关键时机！

moves.popup_en: Nd5! White's knight occupies a key central square.
...Nfd7 brings the knight back to defend.
